# SecondDraft — Lovable scope

**Deploy from repo root:** landing page only (`src/components/landing/*`, `src/pages/Index.tsx`).

**Do not edit or deploy:** `slack-app/` — Bolt Slack backend, maintained in Cursor.

When changing CTAs, link to `slack-app/SETUP.md` on GitHub or an external install URL — not `/auth` or `/dashboard`.
